content:
I can’t directly hear your microphone or speak through your speakers in this chat.

But yes, we can still do voice conversation if your app or device supports:
- speech-to-text for your mic
- text-to-speech for my replies

If you want, I can help you:
- set up voice mode in your app
- keep replies short and natural for speaking
- format responses like a live conversation

If your goal is real-time voice chat, tell me what device/app you’re using.
